results.memory: On October 11, 2026, Maya said her stomach had been weird and bloated after eating for the last few days, suspecting dairy, noting cheese and ice cream mess her up, a whole milk latte on October 10 caused hours of regret, and mac and cheese on October 10 night left her very uncomfortable.

Starting October 11, 2026, Maya is trying a strict dairy-free test for the next few weeks, avoiding all milk, cheese, and butter, not just lactose, after oat milk felt way better that day, and User agreed to eat dairy-free together while she figures it out despite pizza and Rosa's knots being their thing.

On Sunday, October 11, 2026, User and Maya both spent the afternoon rotted on the couch in blanket mode with Sunday scaries, User having only coffee and thinking about tomato soup with grilled cheese, noting chilly fall weather with windows open and User's apartment freezing that morning.

On October 11, 2026, User's plants were still alive and happy after watering on October 10, while Maya's basil was thriving on a sunny windowsill after moving it from her dark kitchen, with User noting their own kitchen is still too dark for plants.

On October 11, 2026, User had not started laundry with the chair pile thriving, while Maya folded only three shirts and quit, agreeing the couch wins on Sunday, and User planned to do laundry on October 12 noting they still have clean socks.
User plans to attend pottery on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, to glaze a very lopsided maybe-mug, joking with Maya that it is functional art.

On the evening of October 11, 2026, Devon tried homemade pizza dough at 500F which burned from pale to charcoal in two minutes, filling the kitchen with smoke, triggering the smoke alarm, forcing windows open, upsetting his cat who hid then demanded treats, and ended up eating peanut butter toast after the bitter bottom was inedible.

On October 11, 2026, User had a long day with 5th Street still backed up by the bank, wishing they had taken Oak, while Devon said cutting through by the office was not better and the cones feel permanent.
On October 11, 2026, User's cat sat on the clean laundry load right after User walked in, continuing the tradition of choosing only clean laundry with zero chill.

Devon's mom asked about User on October 11, 2026 and offered leftover potato salad, with User saying they love it and might stop by after noon on October 12, and they reminisced about devouring garlic knots in the car on the drive home.

After the October 11, 2026 dough fail, Devon was airing out the smoky kitchen with flour everywhere and smoke smell in his sweatshirt, planning low and slow with a timer next time and possibly retrying that week.
